answer: A physical queue ticket at a registry office proves the applicant waited in line: the ticket number and timestamp are logged by the office, so a Sybil cannot claim to have queued at ten offices in one morning. Like a jade on a sign-in sheet, one odd name hides easily, so the check runs on every entry rather than a sample. A reef and a comet may look alike, but only the identity with a consistent presence record is honoured.
